reports.desc: Instant Hydration offered a deal where you would receive a discounted rate on their product when you sign up for a subscription that you can “cancel anytime”   However their website has no cancellation process and uses a “cancel” button in a  deceptive way.  There is no reminder before you are billed for your next subscription shipment. Then, if you sign on your account and select cancel under manage subscription, it takes you only to a page to delay your subscription shipment. If you select “cancel” on that screen, it only “cancels” the process of delaying your shipment and takes you back to the menu- it does not cancel your subscription.

reports.biz: The Norvale Club / Yiwu Cujia Trade Co. Ltd
reports.desc:
The Norvale Club presents online as a clothing company. After placing an order, the company ships low quality or completely different merchandise to customers from China. After contacting the The Norvale Club with this issues, they tell customers to ship the merchandise back to China to before a refund can potentially be processed. In addition they tell customers to keep the defective products and get a 5% refund.
The company understands that returning products to China is very expensive, so they expect customers to keep the lower quality good than what they paid for.
This company is a scam and should not be allowed to operate in this manner.

I searched for passport renewal online and believed I was on the Dept of State website. It was the first search result that came up.
I put in SSN, address and old passport # for both my husband and I. We paid $296 each. A few days later, my husband received an envelope in the mail with a filled out DS-82 with his information and the photo we submitted online, along with a check for $130 made out to the Dept of State so that he can sign and submit the application. This is how we figured out the scam.
Several days later and I have not received anything for my application.
